rows.value: For each (M, w) in [8, 16, 40] x [1.0, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4], at S = 80: a driver arm (b_enabled=False, nu=0) OWNS the memory so the MemoryState sequence is identical across arms; every arm shares ONE BilinearValueHead so psi_hat is bit-identical; 12 streams/seed, 5 seeds. A FLIP is an eviction where the b-enabled arm's victim differs from the b-free driver's on the same state. The stream's sentence gestalts come from the topic model with max(2, M//2) topics per stream, so c_t (the sentence just written) is topic-correlated with the memory contents by construction. Arms: ['formula_M', 'fixed_0.1']. EMA half-life = M/4 in both.

rows.value: Exact-cosine near-duplicate pairs. A fraction f = 0.25 of the n slots is replaced by rho*g_src + sqrt(1-rho^2)*e_perp with e_perp orthogonalized against g_src, so cos(g_dup, g_src) = rho EXACTLY (not inferred, and not the additive construction the brief warns about). rho in [0.0, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99]; rho = 0 is the control and runs the identical code path. Order statistic: 800 groups per (n, rho) cell, independent unit context, 5 seeds. Flip runs: the stream version injects, at every step with probability f, a near-copy at cosine rho of a RANDOM LIVE SLOT's gestalt; the three RNG draws happen at every step and every rho so the sweep is RNG-matched.

verdict.detail: THE TWO NUMBERS SIDE BY SIDE, on b_max / median-top-2-z-margin. M EFFECT, iid, M = 8 -> 40: 1.6692 +/- 0.1204 (order statistic) and 1.6521 +/- 0.1705 (live memory). REDUNDANCY EFFECT at FIXED M = 40 depends on the STRUCTURE of the redundancy, not on its mean, and that is the load-bearing finding. (i) BROAD moderate correlation (topic model, two members per topic) at achieved mean-max-cosine 0.6207 +/- 0.0008 moves it only 1.1443 +/- 0.0821 (order statistic) / 1.1795 +/- 0.1062 (live memory), and the flip rate only 1.0107 +/- 0.0383 -- a component shared by every live slot is a common additive offset in psi_hat, and _score subtracts the per-step mean one operation earlier. (ii) NEAR-DUPLICATE pairs at exact cosine rho = 0.99, fraction f = 0.75, achieved mean-max-cosine 0.9804 +/- 0.0004, move it 4.0325 +/- 0.1175 (order statistic) and 2.3710 +/- 0.2103 (live memory, achieved cosine 0.7308 +/- 0.0098), while the REALIZED FLIP RATE moves only 1.1080 +/- 0.0384. So the two readouts disagree and both numbers are reported: redundancy reaches the M effect on the MARGIN (crossing at an achieved mean-max-cosine of 0.5413 +/- 0.0319 order statistic / 0.5426 +/- 0.0437 live memory) but NOT on the flip rate (0/5 seeds reached it). The broad-correlation sweep reaches neither inside its range (crossings found: 0/5 order statistic, 0/5 live memory). FLIP RATES, M axis: the M = 8 -> 40 swing under correction 4's own gamma_b = 4/M is 1.3135 +/- 0.0643. ANISOTROPY: achieved participation ratio falls from 384.0 at alpha = 0 to 4.1 at alpha = 2.0, moving the M = 40 ratio by 1.4281 +/- 0.2752. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF.
